description: This file defines a custom exception class `UnknownCommandResponseException` which is thrown when a command response is not supported by the protocol adapter. It includes builder methods for constructing instances with specific details, and references external JSON and HTTP-related classes.

classes.name: UnknownCommandResponseException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating that a command response is not supported by the adapter, with builder support for construction.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A builder class for creating instances of `UnknownCommandResponseException` with a fluent API.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs an `UnknownCommandResponseException` from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an `UnknownCommandResponseException` from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the exception with updated headers.
